title: Freelance Hourly & Day Rate Calculator for Professionals
description: Work out the minimum hourly and day rate you need as a consultant, freelancer or agency, from your target income, business costs, tax and billable hours.
h1: What should you charge? Work out your minimum rate
intro: Many independent professionals underprice because they forget non-billable time, holidays, tax and business costs. This calculator builds them all in.

blocks.html:
Hourly and day rate calculator

Work out the minimum rate you need to charge to reach your target income, after business costs and tax.

sections.html: Selling, admin, learning and invoicing all take time you can’t bill. If you plan on billing every working hour, your rate will be too low. Be realistic about how many hours a week clients will actually pay for.

sections.h2: From minimum rate to market rate
sections.html:
• Check what similar specialists charge in your market.
  • Consider fixed fees or retainers for repeat work. See pricing models explained.
  • Review your rates at least once a year.

Want more clients? See how to get listed on ProSourced.

faqs.q: Which tax rate should I use?
faqs.a: Use an estimate of the overall tax and social contributions on your profit where you live. An accountant can give you a more accurate figure.

faqs.q: Should I quote hourly or a day rate?
faqs.a: Hourly suits small or unpredictable tasks. Day rates suit consulting and project work. Fixed fees reward efficiency, if the scope is clear.

cardText: Turn your income goal, costs, tax and billable hours into a minimum rate.
